newsitem.title: USA: Kodak cuts digital camera price by 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kodak cuts digital camera price by 20 pct.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said on Monday it cut the price of its Digital Science DC25 camera by 20 percent to an expected retail price of $399 in the United States.
Introduced last September at the price of $499, the DC25 camera is designed for personal picture-taking and for sharing images via computer on-line.
The DC25 camera allows picture-takers to view their pictures immediately through a color display on the camera back. The DC25 camera package also includes a bundle of computer software.
